name: gems65-sar2inv-a2-38k
note: SAR-PU, propensity anchored on 2 public fault inventories; rank P(y|x)*(1-e(x)); 38k dots, 300m NMS, 300m peel

ship_decision.rule_text: Ship A2_sar_1me if (i) the primary gate passes for A1_sar over B_nnpu, (ii) A2 does not lose to A1 on I1 by more than the width of its own 95% CI, and (iii) A2 beats A1 on I2. Otherwise ship A1_sar if the gate passes, and if the gate fails ship nothing: log the negative result and mark the artifact DO-NOT-SUBMIT.
ship_decision.reason: primary gate failed: A1_sar did not beat B_nnpu on I1

validation.validation_class: local format/range preflight; not organizer acceptance or uniqueness clearance

propensity.reason: anchor primary per the brief (a public reference index exists); the EM is reported as a sensitivity arm. EM diagnostics: Spearman vs anchor +0.598, std(e) 0.00140 vs anchor std(e) 0.25147

pi_receipt.note: both inventories are incomplete, so this is a lower bound on the true fault-pixel prevalence; the nnPU baseline needs a pi and this is the only measurement available in-sandbox.

source_errors: Legacy list has no complete-inventory certificate; diagnostic only
summary.scope: All hash-verified accessible entries in the indexed public owner-repository inventory; not a complete organizer registry. External/private/unlinked/inaccessible files may be absent. Reverse overlap is diagnostic only.

two_phase.scope_note: Checked against every registry raster whose bytes are present locally (plus any explicitly fetched witnesses). Un-fetched registry entries are a stated scope limitation, never a claim of absence.

literal_reading.note: Keeps the inherited literal support definition. A continuous-surface prior fires on every nonempty candidate, so a firing here is not evidence of duplication; it is reported for completeness.

like_for_like_reading.note: Inherited thresholds, applied to dot fields only; rank correlation still applies to every raster including the continuous surfaces.

registry_meta.note: the certified index covers 19 prior submissions; the remaining rasters are calibration/candidate fields from the same family and are scanned as extra comparators, flagged as not-in-certified-index

control_distance_only.note: same budget, same NMS, same peel; no learning. Reported because the sibling repository measured this control beating its own headline candidate.
